sourceRefs.locator: “Danmarks længste bro i tusind år” and “En imponerende konstruktion”. Measurements and construction, wood joints, variable post lengths, suggested traffic, local attribution to Harald and conventional date c. 980.

KUML 52, figs 1 and 3; Danish discussion on pp. 216 and 220–221 and the English conclusion pp. 224–225. The last identified ring yields autumn 979 as a lower limit. Missing bark and revised sapwood statistics give a felling range of roughly 980–1010.
Q996217, P625. General location in the Vejle river valley.
